description: This is the main entry point for a React-based front-end application. It imports React and ReactDOM libraries, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App inside a DOM element with id 'root' inside a React StrictMode component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for React rendering inside a specific DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the specified root.
